## Expected and observed behaviour

- Requirement and test ID
- Provider mode, synthetic input and safe reproduction steps
- Expected result and side effects
- Actual result with sanitised evidence

## Verification

- Regression scenario, outcome and test command
- Linked fix PR and supporting note when available
